Africa on Transvaal constitution, 1906; mem. of hon. man. comtee. of sleeping sickness bureau, 1908; chmn., et. of dir., Br. N. Borneo Co., 1910.

RIDGWAY, T. R. V.—Ast. supt., pol., Kenya, Dec., 1923.

RIGBY, JAMES PHILIP CLAYTON.—Ed. Westminster Schl. and Trinity Coll., Cambridge (Westminster exhib.).—barrister-at-law. Lincoln's Inn; ag. dep. regiir., sup. ct., Singapore, Aug., 1898; ag. sheriff, 1899; regiir. of cts., Larut, 1901; ag. mag., Larut, 1902; ag. state treas., Perak, 1907; ag. astt. ditto, Larut, 1911; ag. astt. regiir., sup. ct., Ipoh, 1916; regiir., sup. ct., Kuala Lumpur, 1920; offr. cls. II., Jan., 1924; pub. for F.M.S. Govt., "The Law of Perak," under gen. editorship of R. J. Wilkinson.

RIGBY, WILLIAM EDWARD.—B. 1897; ed. at Bury Gram. Schl.; 2nd lieut., Lancs. Fusiliers, Sept., 1910; served in France from Aug., 1916 to Mar., 1918, and from June, 1918 to Nov., 1919; awarded the M.C. and the Croix de Guerre; cadet, S. Sttlmts., 20th Nov., 1920; attd. to Chinese prot., Penang, 21st Dec., 1920; attd. to Chinese prot., Singapore, 28th Feb., 1921; proceeded to Canton to study Chinese, 5th July, 1921.

RIGNELL, JOHN HERBERT.—B. 1886; Scots Guards, 1904-14; mily. prov., staff corps, 1911; warrant offr., cl. I., 1920-25; served in U.K., Ceylon and Malta; phys. instr., Achimota, Gold Coast, 1925.

RIMINGTON, CAPT. G.B.—Ast. dist. commr., Kenya, May, 1920.

RINFRET, FERNAND, B.A., F.R.S.C.—Elec. to House of Commons, Canada, 1920-25; sec. of state, 1926.

RIPPON, STEWART ROSS, M.R.C.V.S.—B. 1896; lieut., R.A.V.C., 16th Jan., 1917; serv. in Salonica, Macedonia, and with Army of Black Sea; capt., Jan., 1918; demob., 25th Jan., 1921; vety. offr. Gold Coast, 20th May, 1921.

RISLEY, SIR JOHN SHUCKBURGH, K.C.M.G. (1922), K.C. (1921), C.B. (1912)—B. 1867; ed. at Marlborough and Magd. Coll., Oxford (classical exhibitioner); 2nd class classical moda., 1888; 2nd class jurisprudence, 1890; open studentship, Inns of Court, 1892; called to the bar, 1893; M.A. and B.C.L., 1894; author of "The Founding of St. Stephen's Golf Club," 1893; "The Law of War," 1897; "Notes and Echoes," 1902; editor of Dale's "Clergyman's Legal Handbook," 7th edition; joint editor of Waterloo's "Companies Acts Manual," 11th and 12th editions; legal assistant, C.O., March, 1901; legal adviser, 19th May, 1911.

RITCHIE, GEORGE LE HARRIVEL KERR BAINBRIDGE.—Natal Civ. Serv., 1891; lieut., 1st batt., N.R.R., 1892; served with Mashonaland Field Force, 1896, attached to Rhodesian Horse, present at the relief of Ft. Charter, Ft. Salisbury, Mazoe, and Hartley Hills, ment. in desp. (medal and clasp); astt. collr., Nyassaland Prot., Dec., 1897; 2nd grade resident, Apr., 1907.

RITCHIE, J. D.—Cik., agril. dept., Kenya, Aug., 1912; head cik. and acct., cust. dept., Sept., 1922.

RITCHIE, HON. JAMES JOHNSTONE.—B. 1866; ed. Annapolis Acad. and King's Coll. Schl., Windsor, N.S.; LL.B., Harvard Law Schl.; admitted to Bar of N.S., Dec., 1877; K.C., 1890; pres., N.S. Barristers Soc., 1910 and 1911; just., sup. ct., N.S., 16th Feb., 1912; judge in equity and judge of ct. for divorce and matrimonial causes, 12th May, 1915.

RIVERS-SMITH, STANLEY, C.B.E. (1926), O.B.E. (1919), M.A. (Cantab).—B. 1877; ed. at St. Lawrence Coll., Ramsgate, and St. Catharine's Coll., Cambridge, (exhibtn.); entd. Egyptian civ. serv., 27th Sept., 1905; dir. of educn., Zanzibar, 2nd Oct., 1907; Order of the Aliyeh Zanzibar, 3rd cls., 1909; seconded for mil. serv., K.A.R., Dec., 1916 to Dec., 1918; Order of the Brilliant Star, Zanzibar, 3rd cls., 1920; dir. of educn., Tanganyika Territory, 12th Sept., 1920; Swahili examr.; mem., exec. coun., 1925.

ROACH, B. S.—B. 1864; entd. educn. dept., S. Australia, 1879; head teacher, 1891; editor of "Children's Hour" and "Education Gazette"; inspr. of schls. since 1915.

ROBB, HON. JAMES ALEXANDER.—B. 1859; ed. at dist. schl. and Huntington Acad.; mayor of Valleyfield, 1906-10; cl. to H.C., 1908, 1911, 1917 and 1921; min. of trade and commerce in King admnstr., 29th Dec., 1921; min. of immigr. and colonisation, 1923; min. of finance and recvr. gen., 5th Sept., 1925.

ROBERT, FREDERIC.—Admitted a solicitor of sup. ct. of Mauritius, 1885; ag. mag., Rodrigues, from Nov., 1895, to Dec., 1896, June, 1897, to Sept., 1898, and Apr., 1900, to June, 1901; dist. cik. and sen. civ. status offr., Plaines Wilhems, Cure-
pipe division, 15th July, 1901; ag. regisr.-gen., May to Oct., 1903; ag. mag., Rodrigues, 1st Apr., 1904; ag. dist. and stip. mag. of Mauritius, 20th July, 1904; ag. mag., Lesser Dependencies, 19th Sept., 1904, confirmed as such, 11th Sept., 1905; confirmed as dist. and stip. mag., Mauritius, 1st Oct., 1907.

ROBERTS, ARTUR HALLAM, B.A. (Cantab.)—B. 1888; ed. Aldenham schl. and Jesus Coll., Camb.; called to bar. Inner Temple, Nov., 1914; cadet, Fiji, Jan., 1915; priv. sec. to gov., Mar., 1915; ag. 1st cls. clk., col. sec's office and clk. to exec. and leg. coun., Jan., 1916; passed cadet, June, 1916; priv. sec., Oct., 1916; 2nd grade dist. commr., 15th Oct., 1916; ag. crown solr., July, 1917; assigned dist. of Savu Savu, Aug., 1917; ast. serv., June, 1918; dist. commr., Navua, Dec., 1919; resigned, Oct., 1920; el. mem., leg. coun., 1923-26; registr., sup. ct., taxing master, curator, pub. trustees and offi. recr. in bankruptcy, 7th Mar., 1927.

ROBERTS, CHARLES CLIFTON, B.A.—Ed., St. Paul's Schl. and Keble Coll., Oxford; called to the bar, Middle Temple, 1910; ast. atty.-gen., Nyasaland Prot., Nov., 1919; ag. atty.-gen., May to Oct., 1920, Mar., 1921, to Jan., 1922 and from Feb. to Apr., 1924; senr. mag., Uganda, June, 1924; ag. atty.-gen., Sept., 1924 to Feb., 1925; ag. puisne judge, Mar. to Sept., 1925.

ROBERTS, DAVID GWYN.—Clk., accounting dept., Cape Govt. rlyws., 1902; passed Cape civ. serv. exam., 1st class, Nov., 1902; clk., col. sec's office, Jan., 1903; transf'd to treasy., Sept., 1908; voluntarily retired from Cape civ. serv., Feb., 1909; clk., customs dept., Nyasaland Prot., 7th Oct., 1910; ast. traffic auditor, Gold Coastrlyws., 24th Sept., 1913.

ROBERTS, GEORGE FURSE.—B. 1881; ed. Univ. Coll., London; telegraphist, G.P.O., Sept., 1897; 2nd div. clk., exchequer and audit dept., Apr., 1900; cadet, Ceylon civ. ser., Dec., 1905; off. ast. to govt. agt., Uva Prov., Apr., 1907; pol. mag., Panadure, Jan., 1909; Jaffna, Dec., 1909; ast. govt. agt., Hambantota, Nov., 1911; dist. judge, Nuwara Eliya, and comsnr. of requests and pol. mag., Nuwara Eliya-Hatton, May, 1912; pol. mag., Galle, Mar., 1915; pol. mag., Colombo, Mar., 1916; tes. comsnr., Nov., 1918; controller of estate supplies, in addition to his own duties, May, 1919; comsnr. of requests, Colombo, Nov., 1921; ag. ast. P.M.G., Mar., 1922; rubber contr., Oct., 1922; dist. judge, Kurunegala, Nov., 1925; ditto, Negombo, Nov., 1926.

ROBERTS, MAJOR GEORGE DOUGLAS.—B. 1869; ed. Chanonry House, Aberdeen; served in Anglo-Boer war, 1901-02; S. African constab., 1904-06; sub-inspr., Swaziland pol., 1907; adjt., training depot, England, 1914-18; inspr., 1918; staff offr., pol., 1923.

ROBERTS, JACOB THOMAS.—B. 1874; ed. at C.M.S. Collegiate schl., Lagos; clerical ast., qrtmr.'s off., Hausa force, 16th Sept., 1898; 6th cls. elk., 3rd Aug., 1899; ast. storekeeper, med. dept., 1st Jan., 1900; ag. med. storekeeper and warden, Lagos hosp., 4th Nov., 1903, to 3rd Jan., 1904; 4th cls. elk., med. dept., 1st Apr., 1904; 3rd cls. elk., audt.off., 1st Feb., 1905; 2nd cls. elk., ditto, 1st Jan., 1907; 1st cls. elk., ditto, 1st Jan., 1908; in charge of audit off., Ebute Metta, 21st Jan. to 26th Feb., 1908; ast. chief clk., audit off., 1st Jan., 1911.

ROBERTS, JOHN EDWIN THEOPHILUS.—Ed. Mico Coll., Jamaica; head teacher, St. Mary's Schl., St. Kitts; head teacher, Road Town Wes. Sohl., Virgin Is.; elk. to comsnr., Virgin Is., Mar., 1917; ag. educnl. dist. offr., Oct., 1919-Feb., 1920; educnl. dist. offr., Mar., 1920; elk. mag., and bailiff, sup. ct., Apr., 1921; comsnr. as admstr. oaths, July, 1921.

ROBERTS, PERCY HAMER.—Prison offr., Br. Guiana, 19th Nov., 1901; served penal settltn., Massaruni, and at Essequibo and Georgetown county prisons; clerical ast., Georgetown and Essequibo prisons; gaoler, G. Coast, 5th Mar., 1911; keeper, James Fort prison, 1st June, 1911.

ROBERTS, THOMAS WEBB.—B. 1880; ed. Hertford Coll., Oxford; cadet, Ceylon civ. ser., Oct., 1902; pol. mag., Matara, Aug., 1905; Panadure, Sept., 1906; dist. judge, Chilaw, Feb., 1909; ag. dist. judge, Batticaloa, May, 1912; comsnr. of requests, Colombo, Feb., 1914; ast. comsnr. of excise, Mar., 1917; excise comsnr., Aug., 1920; dist. judge, Galle, Sept., 1927.

ROBERTS, WILLIAM RODICK.—B. 1880; war serv., three years, nine months, R.N. and R.N.A.S.; gaol tech. instr., prisons dept., Gold Coast, 12th Jan., 1921; mast., Accra tech. schl., 31st Oct., 1923; seconded to prisons dept., 31st Oct. to 30th Nov., 1923; housemast., 28th Apr., 1926.

ROBERTSON, COLIN CHARLES, M.F.—Probationary forest offr., O.F.S., Feb., 1903; studied forestry in Europe and at Yale Univ., 1905-07; ast. conservator of forests, O.F.S., 1907; dist. forest offr., and research offr., Pretoria, 1912; professional ast., 1917; on active service with S.A.H.A., Apr., 1917 to July, 1919; ag. conservator, forests, Eastern conservancy, 1919, Natal and Midland conservancies, 1920; resumed duties of prof. ast. to chief conservator of forests, Oct., 1920.

ROBERTSON, GEORGE WATSON, M.R.C.S. (Eng.), L.R.C.P. (Lond.)—Govt. pathologist, Cape Town and med. offr. in ch., govt. vaccine stat., Cape Town, 1921; ret., but apptd. in part time capacity as med. offr. in ch., govt. vaccine inst. and consulting pathologist to Union dept. of pub. health, Cape Town, 21st Nov., 1926.

ROBERTSON, HON. GIDEON DECKER.—B.1874; ed. pub. and high schls., Welland, Ontario; called to the senate, Canada, 1917; mem. of the P.C. for Canada, 1918; cabinet min. without portfolio; min. of labour in Union Govt., 7th Nov., 1918 to 29th Dec., 1921.

ROBERTSON, J. P.—B. 1875; ed. Trinity Coll., Dublin; headmaster, govt. boys' schl., Accra, G. Coast, 11th Apr., 1908; inspr. of schls., 1st Jan., 1911; provincial inspr. of schls., 1st Jan., 1915; lieut., G. Coast volunteers; ag. dir., educn., 4th July to 4th Aug., 1925; ast. dir., educn., 1927.

ROBERTSON, THOMAS ROBERT.—B. 1875; ed. Glenalmond, M.B., Ch.B., Edin.; formerly house surgeon and physician, Swansea hosp. and Victoria Park hosp. for chest diseases; civil surg., S. African Field Force, 1901-2 (medal and three clasps); ast. comsnr. and gen. med. offr., Salt Cay, Turks Is., 1905; dist. comsnr. and gen. med. offr., Caicos Is., 1905; gen. med. offr., Grand Turk, 1909.

ROBERTSON, SIR W. C. F., K.C.M.G. (1927), C.M.G. (1919).—Ed. Trin. Coll., Dublin; exhibitor, 1886 and 1887; classical scholar, 1888; classical moderator, 1889; inspr. of schls., G. Coast, 1898; director of educn., 1899; ag. comptroller of cust., 1899; compiled census rept., 1901; ag. sec. for native aff airs, 14th June to 19th Nov., 1905; prov. comsnr., 20th Nov.,
DOMINIONS OFFICE AND COLONIAL OFFICE LIST.

1905; sec. for native affairs, 18th May, 1907; ag. col. sec., 4th July to 25th Sept., 1908; chief asst. col. sec., 22nd Jan., 1909; ag. col. sec., in 1909, 1910, 1911, 1912, 1913; deputy gov., Jan., 1910; dep. gov., Dec., 1912, and April to May, 1913; ag. gov., 1st May to 27th Aug., 1914; dep. gov., 28th Aug. to 6th Sept., 1914; col. sec., Gibraltar, 12th Feb., 1915; lieut.-gov. and chief sec. to gov't., Malta, May, 1917; offr. admgt. govt., Malta, for various periods, 1920-25; gov't.'s dep., 1st to 13th Oct., 1920; lieut. gov. by comrn. under new constitution, 14th Apr., 1921; gov't. dep., for various periods in 1920 and 1922; hon. LL.D., Malta Univ., 1925; gov', Barbados, 1925.

ROBIN, MAJOR - GENERAL SIR ALFRED WILLIAM, K.C.M.G. (1916), C.B. (1900).—B. 1861; ed. privately and at Otago high schl.; N. Zealand vol. offr.; comd. squadn., N. Zealand mtd. rifles, Queen Victoria's diamond jub., 1897; comd. 1st N. Zealand contngt., S. Africa, 1899-1901; comdt., Otago mil. dis., 1902-07 (brev. col.); chief of gen. staff and 1st mil. mem. of coun. of defence, 1907-11 (col.); adjt. and qtrm.-gen., 1911-12; represented N. Zealand on Imperial gen. staff, War Off., 1912-13; comdt. and G.O.C., N. Zealand mil. forces, 1914-19; maj.-gen., 1916.

ROBINSON, AUBREY CHARLES.—B. 1875; ed. Lancing Coll., and Hertford Coll., Oxford; B.A.; called to the bar, Inner Temple, Nov., 1901; practised at the bar, Jamaica, 1901 to 1911; comrnr., and judge of grand ct., Cayman Is., Jan., 1913; compd. revised edition of Laws of Cayman Is. (published, deferred during the war); reglar.-gen., Bahamas, Jan., 1918; perf. duties of S. and C. mag. in July and Dec., 1918, and from 25th Mar., 1919; reglar.-gen., Trinidad, Aug., 1919; ag. reglar., supt. ot. and marshal, June to Sept., 1920; res. mag., Jamaica, Sept., 1923.

ROBINSON, FRANKLYN.—B. 1878; M.A., Durham Univ.; barrister, Inner Temple, 1915; cadet, S. Sttlmts., Oct., 1902; ag. head of Malay Coll., Malacca, Apr., 1903; demarcation offr., Malacca, 4th Dec., 1903; passed final exam. in Malay, Jan., 1904; mag., June, 1904; passed cadet, July, 1904; ag. dist. offr., Jasin, Dec., 1905; ag. dep. reglar. of sup. ct., sheriff, mag., comrnr. of ct. of requests, reglar. of marriages, and chmn. of bd. of licensing justices, Malacca, Sept., 1907; ag. 3rd mag., Penang, Dec., 1907; ag. dist. offr., Prov. Wellesley, Mar., 1908; 3rd mag., Singapore, Mar., 1910; ag. dist. offr., Nibong Tebal, 5th Apr., 1912; ditto, Butterworth, 22nd Aug., 1913; ag. reglar., sup. ct. dist. judge and mag., Malacca, 26th Sept., 1913; offr. of cls. IV., 1st Aug., 1913; asst. dist. offr., Krian, 9th Aug., 1915; ag. 1st mag., Johore Bahru, 28th Dec., 1915; services lent to Kelantan govt., 14th Dec., 1917; dist. offr., Temerloh, 16th Jan., 1919; ag. asst. to atty.-gen., Nov., 1919; offr., cls. II., F.M.S., Jan., 1920; ag. reglar., sup. ct., Penang, Aug., 1920; ag. legal adviser and judge, Kedah, Oct., 1920; judge, 1st divn. under new courts enactment, continued to act as legal adviser in addn., 8th Sept., 1921; ag. dep. pub. pros., Penang, 1st Mar., 1922; ag. legal adviser, Kedah, May, 1924.

ROBINSON, INNES LOVELL.—B. 1904; ed. Marlborough and Jesus Coll., Cambridge (2nd cls. hons. classics); cadet, Tanganyika, 1927.

ROBINSON, J. ALEX, M.B.E. (1919).—J.P., notary pub. for the col. (Newfild.); ed. Vict. Coll., Jersey, and New Kingswood, Bath; prin. of Carbonbear gram. schl., 1883-92; aleo. for Bonavista, 1897; col. sec. of Newfild. and mem. of exec. coun., 1897; accepted leadership of legis. coun., Dec., 1897; May, 1898, rotd. to H.A. for dist. of Trinity: mem. treas'y. bd., 1898; M.L.C., 1910; postmr.-gen., 1916.

ROBINSON, S.—B. 1893; ed. Barnsley Gram. Schl. and Univ. of Sheffield; B.A., 1914; 1st ols. hons. mod. lang.; M.A., 1919; on mily. serv., 1914-19; apptd. under reconstruction scheme, junr. clk., bd. of cust. and excise, Sept., 1919; asst. prin., 1st Jan., 1920; transf'd. to C.O. as priv. sec. (appts.) to S. of S., Duke of Devonshire, Nov., 1923; Mr. J. H. Thomas, Jan., 1924; Mr. L. C. M. S. Amery, Nov., 1924.

ROBINSON, LIEUT-COL. SIR THOMAS BILBE, K.C.M.G. (1913), KT. BACH. (1910), K.B.E. (1918).—B. 1853; formerly major in command of 1st Queenslanders, and senior offr. in Cent. Queensland; man. and dir. of various public companies; J.P., Queensland, 1887; pres. of Rockhampton chamber of commerce; Queensland comnr. for Franco-British exhibn.; agt.-gen. for Queensland, 1910; mem. of comtee. for settm. of ex-serv. men within the Empire, 1917.

ROCHE, HON. WILLIAM JAMES, M.D., LL.D.—B. 1859; ed. pub. schl., Lucan, Ontario, and high schl., London, Ontario, Trinity med. coll., Toronto; grad. M.D., with 1st cl. hona., Western Univ., London, Ontario, 1883; 1st grad. in medicine of that Univ.; LL.D., 1911; removed 1883 to Minnedosa, Man., where he is a practising physician; territorial rep. for Manitoba med. coun., 1885-1901; has held highest offices in I.O.O.F., Manitoba; elec. to H. of C., Canada, g.e. 1896; re-elec. g.e. 1900, 1904, 1908 and 1911; conservative whip for the West, 1901-1911; mem. of the privy coun. for Canada, and sec. of state in Mr. Borden's cabinet, Oct., 1911; min. of the Interior, 1912; chmn., civ. serv. comrn., 1917.

ROCK, JOHN CHRISTOPHER WILBERFORCE.—B. 1882; ed. Harrison Coll., Barbados and Jesus Coll., Oxford; cadet, Ceylon civ. ser., Nov., 1905; off. asst. to gov't. agt., S. Prov., June, 1906; Sabaragamuwa, Jan., 1908; pol. mag., Panadure, Dec., 1909; pol. mag., Point Pedro and Chava-kachcheri, Nov., 1911; ag. dist. judge, Tangalla, Oct., 1912: ditto, Matara, Oct., 1913; ditto, Kalutara, Aug., 1920; dep. comrnr. of excise, May, 1921; dist. judge, Matara, Apr., 1925; ditto, Galle, Mar., 1926.

RODD, A. J.—B. 1886; apptd., after exam., asst. library attendant, C.O., 11th Dec., 1905; library attendant, 18th Feb., 1911; supplement. clk., col. audit dept., Feb., 1914; on mil. serv. from 5th Aug., 1914.

RODEN, SIR ROBERT BLAIR, KT. BACH. (1918).—B. 1860; called to the bar, Gray's Inn, 1902; clk., public library, Antigua, 1880; 2nd clk. to the gov', Leeward Is., 1881; acted on several occasions as ch. clk., and as clk. to the legis. and exec. couns., and as a dist. mag., Antigua; also acted as priv. sec. to different gov's. Leeward Is., in 1883, 1890, 1895 and 1896; mag., Nevis, 1890; mem. St. Kitts and Nevis legis. couns., 1891; mem., fed. leg. coun., Leeward Is., 1898-9; mag., Bridgetown, Barbados, 1903; acted on several occasions as judge, petty debt ct., Bridgetown, and judge of the asst. ct. of appeal; visiting justice, Glendairy prisi., 1904; ch. just., St. Vincent, 1912; adminstd. gov't. of St. Vincent from Oct., 1912 to Feb., 1913, and for short periods in Apr., Aug., and Dec., 1913; also from Mar. to Nov., 1914; ch. just., Br. Honduras, Feb., 1915; chmn. of food control comtee., Jan., 1918; ret., 1921.

RODESSE, MAURICE.—B. 1871; Priv. sec. to several puisne judges and ch. justices, S. Sttlmts.,
from 20th May, 1889; acted as dep. regist. or as sheriff and dep. regist., Singapore, on several occasions since 1893; confirmed as sheriff and dep. regist., 1st Jan., 1902; ag. offr. assignee in addition to own duties, Sept. to Oct., 1907; dep. regist. sup. ct., and sheriff in addition, Dec., 1908, and again Apr., 1914; ag. regist., sup. ct. Jan., 1909; hon. gen. sec., agri-horticultural shows in addition, May to Aug., 1910; asst. supt. Indian immigr., May, 1912; ag. marshal, prize off. in addition, Aug., 1914; in charge of regist. and sheriff's office, Dec., 1917.

RODRIGO, EDMUND.—B. 1889; cadet, Ceylon civ. serv., Dec., 1912; attached to Kurunegala Kachcheri, Mar., 1913; ag. pol. mag., Negombo, Nov., 1913; office asst. to govt. agt., W. Prov., May, 1915; mun. mag., Colombo, Oct., 1915; pol. mag., Puttalam, July, 1917; office asst. to govt. agt., Prov. of Sabaragamuwa, Sept., 1918; dist. judge, Batticaloa, Apr., 1920; ditto, Matara, May, 1922; asst. comsrr., excise, Sept., 1924; dep. comsrr., excise, Sept., 1927.

RODRIGUEZ, FAUSTIN ALBERT, M.B., C.M. (Edin.).—B. 1867; entd. med. ser., Trinidad, 1st May, 1904; dist. med. offr., 1st May, 1904.

RODWELL, SIR CEOL HUNTER, K.C.M.G. (1919), C.M.G. (1909).—Ed. Eton and King's Coll., Camb., B.A., 1897; serv. on staff of high comsrr. for S. Africa since Dec., 1900; Imperial sec., Mar., 1904; gov., Fiji, and high comsrr., W. Pacific, 8th Apr., 1918; assumed duty, 10th Oct., 1918; gov. and commdr. in ch., B. Guiana, 1925.

ROGERS, ARTHUR WILLIAM, Sc.D., F.R.S.—B. 1872; ed. Clifton Coll. and Christ's Coll., Camb.; Harkness scholar, Camb.; geologist, geological comsrr., Cape of Good Hope, 1896; ast. dir., geological surv., Union of S. Africa, 1st Apr., 1912; dir. geological survey of Union of S. Africa, 1917.

ROGERS, WALTER ERNEST.—B. 1864; entd. civ. serv., S. Australia, 9th Mar., 1882; 2nd clk., audit dept., 1st Feb., 1912; audr.-gen., S. Aust., 1923.

ROGERSON, WALTER JOHN LANCASHIRE, B.A., Cantab.—B. 1889; Cadet, Ceylon civ. serv., Dec., 1912; attached to Kandy Kachcheri, Jan., 1913; ag. additional office asst., Anuradhapura Kach., Jan., 1914; ag. ast. govt. agt., Trincomalee, May, 1914; addtl. office asst. Anuradhapura, June, 1914; ag. office asst. to govt. agt., Kandy, June, 1914; ag. ast. govt. agt., Matale, Sept., 1914; office asst. to govt. agt., Badulla, Sept., 1914; pol. mag., Matale, Jan., 1915; office asst. to govt. agt., Kandy, May, 1917; pol. mag., Avissawella, Jan., 1921; ditto, Kandy, Feb., 1921; dist. judge Kegalla, Sept., 1922; pol. mag., Colombo, July, 1923; asst. govt. agt., Colombo, Nov., 1925; ag. ast. govt. agt., Matale, Apr., 1926.

ROLAND, FREDERICK MALCOLM.—Called to bar, Middle Temple, 1913; mag., county St. Patrick, Trinidad, 1st Mar., 1926.

ROLLESTON, HON. FRANCOIS JOSEPH, B.A., LL.B.—B. 1873; ed. Christ's Coll. and Canterbury Univ. Coll., N.Z.; entd. N.Z. parl., 1922; min. of defence, min. of just. and atty-gen., 1926.

ROLSTON, CECIL MICHELL.—M.D., C.M., Univ. of Manitoba, Canada, 1895; L.R.C.P., Edin.; L.R.C.S., Edin.; L.R.F.P. and S., Glasgow, 1898; mem. Coll. of Phys. and Surgeons, 1903; F.R.I., pub. health, London; late civil surg., attached to R.A.M.C. during S.African war, 1900-1902 (Queen's medal, 2 clasps; King's medal, 2 clasps); apptd. to Leeward Is. med. serv., 1903; med. offr., dist. "D," Dominica, and ag. med. offr. of pub. instit., 1903; dist. med. offr. of health, Vancouver, B. Columbia, 1908; med. offr., dist. 8, Nevis, 1914; ag. mag., Nevis, May to June, 1916; med. offr., dist. 6, Nevis, Sept., 1915.

ROOS, J. DE V., B.A., LL.B.—B. 1869; adv. of sup. ct., Cape Colony; ditto, S.A.R.; attorney, etc., of sup. of S.A.R.; sworn translator in English, Dutch and Portuguese, sup. ct., Transvaal; Cape parly. service, 1893-7; ag. sec. of law dept., Transvaal, 1st Dec., 1908; ditto and ag. dir. prisons, Transvaal, 1st Jan., 1909; sec. to law dept., 1st May, 1909; re-admitted advoc., sup. ct., Transvaal, 28th June, 1909; dir. prisons, 1st July, 1909; sec. for just. and dir. prisons, Union of S. Africa, 1st Apr., 1912; ag. contr. and audr.-gen., 1st Aug., 1918; contr. and audr.-gen., 9th Dec., 1918; mem., American rly. acctng. offrs' assn.; mem., joint comte. of the universities for professional exams.; mem., societe de comptabilité de France.

ROOS, HON. TIELMAN J. DE V., K.C.—M.L.A. for divn. of Lichtenburg, Union of S. Africa since 1915; min. of just., 30th June, 1924.

ROOTS, NEVILLE, M.Inst.C.E.—Ed. Tonbridge Sch. and City and Guilds Engng. Coll., S. Kensington; held various engng. appts. in U.K., 1897-1904; inspgr. engr., P.W.D., Jamaica, 1908; ast. dir. P.W.D., 1914; ag. dir., Apr., 1920 to Sept., 1921; dep. dir., Apr., 1922.

ROPER, WILLIAM JAMES.—B. 1891; entd. C.A. office, 1907; seconded to Falkland Is., Aug., 1912; ag. priv. sec. to admstr. and clk. to couns., Aug., 1913; chief clk. to col. sec., Jan., 1914; ag. local auditor, Nov., 1914; returned to C.A. office, 1915; served European war (M.G.C., France), 1916-1919; 1st cls. clk., Nyassaland, 15th Jan., 1920; ag. ch. clk., July to Dec., 1921; editor, Gazette, Oct., 1921 to Dec., 1922; ag. 2nd ast. sec. and clk. to exec. and leg. couns., Jan. to Nov., 1922, Mar. to Nov., 1925 and from May to Nov., 1926; organising sec., Nyassaland Vol. Res., Sept., 1926; ag. ch. transport offr., Dec., 1926 to May, 1927.

ROSE, HON. HUGH EDWARD.—B. 1869; ed. at Jarvis St. Collegiate Inst., Univ. of Toronto; (B.A., 1891; LL.B., 1892), and Osgoode Hall; mem. of the firm of Fasken, Cowan, Chadwick and Rose; called to the bar, Ontario, 1894; K.C., 1908; judge of the sup. ct., Ontario, 4th Dec., 1916; examr. in law for some years for University of Toronto and the Law Society of Upper Canada.

ROSEBY, THOMAS ERNEST.—B. 1868; ed. at Sydney Univ.; M.A.; honourman in French and German; senr. clk., Royal Mint, Sydney, 1885-1896; called to the bar, New S. Wales, 1896; also to high ct. of Australia; called to the bar, Mid. Term., 1912; crown proscr., N.S. Wales assizes, 1902-3; Brit. judge of joint ct. and judicial comsrr. for the New Hebrides, Nov., 1903; thanked by S. of S. for memoranda on land suits, 1910; co-author of the joint ct. olv., criminal and land registration procedure codes; puisne judge, sup. ct., Mauritius, Feb., 1917; chmn. of govt. wages comsrr., 1919; chmn. of comte. to advise on treatment of former enemy aliens, 1919; chmn., govt. scholarship grants comte. and chmn., rly. enquiry comsrr., 1923; chmn., Curepipe bd. enquiry comsrr., 1926-7.

ROSS, ALEXANDER HOWARD.—B. 1880; ed. Epsom Coll. and on H.M.S. "Worcester"; supervisor of customs, Gold Coast, 1905; ag. inspr., P.S., 1908 and 1909; ag. dist. comsrr. and
travelling comnr., 1908 and 1909 in Ashanti and Northern Territories; asst. dist. comnr. Ashanti, 1910; ag. prov. comnr., 1912 and 1913; ag. dist. comnr., 1913; dist. comnr., 1914; ag. prov. comnr., Mar. to Oct., 1916; passed in criminal law, Tropical African Service Course; dist. comnr., 1917-18; ag. prov. comnr., Mar. to Sept., 1919; ag. sec., native affrs., May to June, 1919; prov. comnr., Sierra Leone, May, 1920.

ROSS, CHARLES RICHARD.—Clk., P.O. savings bank, Cape, 1890; agric. dept., 1894; clk. and acctnt., office of conservator of forests, Midland Conservancy, Cape, 1895; dist. forest offr., George, Cape, 1897; Kokstad, Transkei, 1901; asst. conservator of forests, Transkeian conservancy, 1907; transf. to King William's Town, 1910; conservator of forests, Eastern conservancy, Cape, 1st Apr., 1912; ditto, Western conservancy, Oct., 1916.

ROSS, EDWARD ANDREW.—B. 1895; ed. Leigh Gram. Schl. and Manchester Univ.; on active serv., 1914-19; M.C.; relinquished comnr., 1921 with rank of capt.; cadet, F.M.S., 1920; ag. asst. contr. of lab., May, 1921; superv. offr., cls. V., May, 1923; ag. dep. contr., lab., Kuala Lumpur, Dec., 1923; ag. asst. dist. offr., lands, Kinta, Mar., 1924; asst. cont., lab., Penang, Mar., 1925; ag. dep. contr., lab. (B), Penang, Jan., 1926; ag. asst. emigrn. comnr., Malaya, Negapatam, May, 1926; offr., cls. IV, May, 1927.

ROSS, GEORGE ARCHIBALD PARK, M.D., Ch.M. (Edin.), D.P.H. (Edin.); diploma, trop. diseases, Liverpool.—B. 1879; S. African War, Lovat's Scouts, 1900-02; Anglo-Portuguese bndry. comnr., Zambesia, 1904-5; native rebellion, Natal, 1906; trop. diseases investig., 1906-10; gov't. pathologist, Natal, 1911; asst. health offr., Union of S. Africa, statnd. in Natal, 1918; major, S. African med. corps, in ch. sleeping sickness bureau, Durban, and sanitation offr., Natal, 1914-19.

ROSS, J. G. H.—Asst. dist. comnr., E.A.P., Sept., 1919; ag. junr. asst. sec., Kenya, 10th Nov., 1919 to 26th Oct., 1919; ag. clk. of exec. and leg. couns., 12th Dec., 1919 to 14th Mar., 1920; editor, offl. Gazette, 6th Feb., 1920 to 31st Mar., 1920.

ROSS, JAMES PAULL.—B. 1881; ed. George Watson's Coll. and Edin. Univ.; M.A.; writer to the Signet; capt., 5th Batt. The Royal Scots (Q.E.R.); declined to retain rank of capt. as permission to rejoin for war serv. refused; asst. dist. comnr., G. Coast, 13th Aug., 1913; ag. asst. col. sec., Feb., 1918; dist. comnr., 9th Apr., 1919; ag. pol. mag., Kumasi, 12th Apr., 1919 to 5th Feb., 1920; ag. asst. col. sec., 29th July to 31st Dec., 1920; ch. census offr. in addn., 1921; asst. col. sec., 1st Jan., 1921; ag. ch. regnr. and sheriff, 15th July, 1921 to 22nd Oct., 1921; senr. asst. col. sec., 15th Nov., 1921; pres., Accra town coun., 1921, 1923, 1924, 1925, 1926 and 1927; comnr. for munic. affrs., 1st Apr., 1926.

ROSS, JAMES SANDFORD.—B. 1884; ed. Merchant Taylors Schl.; mily. serv., 1914-19; N.W. Frontier campaign, 1915; Salonica Field Force, 1916-19; asst. treas., Kenya, 1919.

ROSS, OSWALD F.—Ed. Malvern Coll. and Jesus Coll., Cambridge; capt., N. Staffs. Regt., European War; served Dardanelles expdn., 1915; Mesopotamia, 1916; passed A.T.S. course, 1920; asst. dist. comnr., Gold Coast, 1920.

ROTH, WALTER E.—B. (Oxon), late Demy of Magd. Coll.; M.R.C.S. (Eng.); L.R.C.P. (Lond.); hon. mem. anthrop. societies of Berlin and Florence, and of anthrop. inst., Lond.; late ch. protector of aborigines, Queensland; and Royal comnr. to inquire into condition of natives of W. Aust.; stip. mag., dep. prot. of Indians, and govt. med. offr., Pomeroon River, B. Guiana, 8th Dec., 1906; stip. mag., Demerara River, 1915; author of "Klements of School Hygiene," 1886; "Theatre Hygiene," 1888; "Ethnological Studies among the N.W. Central Aborigines, Queensland," 1897; "N. Queensland Ethnography Bulletins," "Superstitions, Magic and Medicine," 1903; "Burial Ceremonies and Disposal of the Dead," 1907; "Animism and Folk-lore of the Guiana Indians," 1915; "Arts, Crafts and Customs of the Guiana Indians," 1921; translator of Richard Schomburgk's "Travels in Br. Guiana," 1923.

ROUILLARD, JEAN EDMOND.—Ed. Roy. Coll., Maur., and King Henry VIII.'s sch., Coventry; called to bar, Mid. Temp., 1891; licent. laws, Paris, 1891; ag. dist. mag., Plaines Wilhelma, Maur., Oct., 1899; ag. Crown pros., Feb., 1900; Crown pros., leg. advr., pol. mag., etc., Seychelles, 4th Sept., 1900; mag., Rodrigues, July, 1902; dist. and stip. mag., Mauritius, 1913; mast. and regnr., sup. ct., 1st July, 1927.

ROUSE, HAROLD STUART, C.E., A.M.I.C.E.—B. 1888; ed. Truro Coll. and Christ's Hosp.; survr., P.W.D., Hong Kong, Feb., 1912; engr., drainage wks. office, Dec., 1913; transf. to gen. wks. office, P.W.D., Apr., 1915; ag. exec. engr., G.W.O., Sept., 1915-16 and from Feb., 1921 to Oct., 1922; offr. in charge, G.W.O., May, 1924.

ROUTH, REGINALD LAMY.—B. 1856; ed. St. Mary's Hall, Southsea, and Cadet school; frigate, H.M.S. "Conway"; extra master's certif., 1893; master of govt. vessels, Lagos, Apr., 1897; asst. marine supt., Lagos, Dec., 1902; ag. marine supt., Dec., 1903, to June, 1904; comdr., H.M.C.S.Y., "Ivy," S. Nigeria, June, 1906; sen. marine offr., E. Prov., S. Nigeria, May, 1907.

ROWAN, ALBERTUS NICOLAAS.—Examr., deeds office, Transvaal, May, 1902; ch. examr., ditto, Oct., 1906; asst. regnr., deeds, Transvaal, Dec., 1918; regnr., deeds, mining rights, companies, patents, trade marks, designs and copyrights, S.W. Africa, Apr., 1922; regnr., deeds, Transvaal and Swaziland, Mar., 1925; mem., townships bd., Mar., 1925.

ROWATT, HUGH HOWARD.—B. 1861; ed., Ottawa Coll. Inst., and St. Catherine's Affiliated Coll.; ent. civ. serv., Can., 1887, as correspondent; ch. clk., mining lands br., Mar., 1907; contrlr., mining lands, 1912; supt., 1920.

ROWE, GEORGE FREDERICK.—B. 1878; ent. Crown Agents' office, 1896; asst. head, gen. stores dept., 1917; asst. head, pay dept., 1920; cashier, 1921; dep. head, finance dept., 1927.

ROWE, MAJOR R. H., D.S.O., M.C.—B. 1883; ed. Wellington Coll. and Royal Mily. Acad., Woolwich; Royal Art'y., 1902-25; Bermuda and Jamaica, 1902-6; served with native infantry, Nigeria, 1907-10; Northern Hinterland expdn., 1907-8; Niger Cross River expdn., 1908-9; operations against Abini, 1909, and against Munchis, 1910; dep. dir., surveys, Nigeria, 1911; Nigeria-Dahomey bndry. comnr., 1912; Great war (Cameroons, France and Russia), 1914-18; survr.-gen., Gold Coast, 1920; comnr., lands, in addn., 1924; survr.-gen., Sierra Leone, in addn., 1925; Gold Coast rep. with staff of H.R.H. the Prince of Wales on his visit to W. Africa, 1925; chmn., comtees, on pub. wks. accts., rly. constr., mun. finance and mily. defence; mem., leg. coun., 1926; comnr., lands, Nigeria, 27th Oct., 1926.
ROWELL, THOMAS HUBERT.—Ck., loco. dept., I.M.R., Pretoria, Oct., 1900; acctg. brch., ch. loco. supt.'s office, Jan., 1903; acctg. offr., ch. mech. engr.'s dept., July, 1906; inspr., audit dept., S.A.R. and Harbrs., Oct., 1910; inspr., asst. contr. and audr. gen.'s dept., Union of S. Africa, May, 1911; inspr., (rly. and hbrs.) control and audit dept., 1st July, 1916; senr. inspr., 1st Oct., 1922; ag. ch. inspr., rly. and harbrs., 24th Apr. to 11th Sept., 1924.

ROWEN, F. C. P.—B. 1896; copyist, audit dept., B. Honduras, 1912; 3rd cls. clk., atty.-gen.'s off., 1915; 2nd cls. clk., ditto, 1918; clk. to regisr.-gen., 1919; sec., riot enquiry comnr., 1919; ag. regisr.-gen. and cust. enemy ppty. and contr. local clearing office, 1920; sec., yellow fever enquiry comnr., 1921; again ag. regisr. gen., 1921, 1923 and 1925; regisr.-gen., regisr., lands titles, regisr., sup., vice-adm'y. and bankcy. cts., regisr., companies and patents and regisr., births marriages and deaths, 1927; J.P.; stamp comnr., dir., pub. offr. guarantee fund; comnr., income tax, 1927.

ROWLEY, FORTESCUE WILLIAM.—B. 1874; ed. Canterbury Univ. Coll.; entd. N.Z. dept. of labr., 1893; dep. chief inspr. of factories, 1907; chief ck. and dep. chief inspr., 1911; sec. of labr., ch. inspr. of factories, regisr. of industrial unions, 1914.

BUDDICK, JOHN ARCHIBALD, LL.D.—B.1862, dairy expert; asst. to dairy comnr., Canada, 1891; prin. dairy schl., Kingston, Ont., 1896; dairy comnr., New Zealand, 1898; asst. to comnr. of agr., Can., 1900; dairy comnr., Can., 1905; dairy and cold storage comnr., Can., 1908; hon. LL.D. (Queen's Univ.), 1924.

RUGGLES, NEPEAN CLARKE, K.C., LL.B.—Barrister of sup. ct., Nova Scotia; Bachelor of Laws at Dalhousie Coll., Halifax, Canada, with honrs. 1891; called to the bar, Nova Scotia, with highest honours, 1891; K.C., Nova Scotia, Jan., 1911, served with the Canadian forces during S. African War; now on the reserve of officers, Canadian militia; public prosecutor at Barberton, Transvaal, 1902; asst. res. mag., 1903 to 1907; mag., dist. F., Dominica, Oct., 1909 to Dec., 1915; ag. mag., Roseau and regisr., sup. ct. in addition on various occasions; took census of Dominica, 1911; mem., leg. coun., Dominica; mag., Grenada, 1915 to 1920; chmn., several commsns. while in Grenada; atty.-gen., St. Vincent, Aug., 1920 to Apr., 1921; ag. ch. just. for short period; 1st cls. stip. mag., B. Guiana, Apr., 1921.

RUNDLE, GEN. SIR HENRY MACLEOD LESLIE, R.A.—B. 1856; G.C.B. (1911); G.C.M.G. (1914); G.C.V.O. (1911); K.C.B., 1898; K.C.M.G., 1901; D.S.O., 1897; ed. Roy. Mil. Acad., Woolwich; entd. R.A., 1876; maj.-gen., 1896; served in Zulu war, 1879; Boer war, 1881; Egyptian war, 1882; Nile expdn., 1884-5; Soudan Frontier field force, 1885-7; Soudan Frontier, 1889; Dongola expdn. force, 1896; adjt.-gen., Egyptian army; Khartoum expdn., 1896; comdg. S.E. Dist., 1898-9; dep. adjt.-gen. to the forces, 1899-1900; in cmd. of div., Aldershot, 1900; lieut.-gen. on staff in cmd. of 8th Div., S. African field force, 1900, 1902; lieut.-gen. of Nthn. Comd., 1903-7; col.-comdt., R.A., 1907; gov. and comdr-in-chief Malta, 1909-1915.

RUSHMER, JAMES.—B. 1876; entered C.O., Oct., 1893; apptd., after exam., library attendant, 1st July, 1896; promoted, after exam., under order-in-council of 1910, clk. of the 2nd div., 18th Feb., 1911; asst. sec. to colonial blue-books comnr., 1917-1918; seconded for serv. at overseas settlement office, Apr., 1920.

RUSHTON, CHARLES BERKELEY.—Ck. comnr. of rly. dept., W. Aust., Apr., 1896; ch. clk., July, 1896; ag. sec. to comnr. of rly., 23rd Aug., 1901; sec. to ditto, 18th Dec., 1901; sec. W. Australian London Agency, 3rd Nov., 1913.

RUSHTON, HERBERT HARVEY.—B.1876; acct., electric light dept., Gibraltar, 1897; asst. sec. and asst. acct., munic. authority, 1902; ch. acct. and asst. sec., 1903; sec. and finan. offr., 1908 (also man., pub. electricity and water supplies, mem., comte. on exchange and currency); asst. ch. acct., Uganda Rly., E. Afr. Prot., 1915; lieut., E.A. Forces, 1915; capt., 1916; ag. dep. ch. acct., Uganda Rly., 1916 to June, 1919 (also gov't. rep., Nairobi munic. conn., 1918, mem., gen. manager's advisory comte., 1919); ag. ch. acct. to Uganda Rly., June to Dec., 1919; dep. treas., Kenya Colony, 1920 and 1921; ag. treas., Aug., 1920 to Apr., 1921; mem., exec. and leg. couns. (also chmn., currency and other comtees.); col. treas., Fiji, 1922 (with charge of group of depts., cust., post and marine, transport, posts, telegraphs and telephones, gvt. stores, and returned soldiers' dairy stltmt.); mem., exec. and leg. couns.; comnr. of currency, mem. educ., mining and other bds.; chmn., many comtees.

RUSSELL, MAJOR-GEN. SIR ANDREW HAMILTON.—K.C.B. (1918); K.C.M.G. (1915).—B. 1868; held comm. as lieut. for 5 yrs. in Imperial Army; vol. offr., New Zealand, 1900; hon. A.D.C. to H.E. the Gov. of N.Z., 1911; brig.-gen., 1914; temp. major-gen., 1915; major-gen. in command of N.Z. Div., 1916; foreign decoration, Order of Danilo (Montenegro), 1917.

RUSSELL, HON. BENJAMIN, K.C., M.A., D.C.L.—Ed. at Halifax gram. schl. and Mount Allison Univ.; called to the bar, 1872; for some years law adviser to legis. coun., Nova Scotia; elec. to H. of C., Canada, 1896; judge of supreme ct., Nova Scotia, 1904.

RUSSELL, THOMAS BROWNLEE.—B. 1873; ed. Pembroke Coll. Oxford, M.A.; cadet, Ceylon civ. ser., Oct., 1897; office asst. to gvt. agt., E. Prov., Mar., 1899; pol. mag., Balapitiya, Nov., 1899; dist. judge, Tangalla, Aug., 1900; office asst. to gvt. agt., N.C. Prov., Nov., 1901; Uva Prov., Nov., 1902; dist. judge, Batticaloa, July, 1903; office asst. to gvt. agent, N. Prov., Nov., 1903; pol. mag., Jaffra, Jan., 1904; ag. dist. judge, Jaffra, Mar., 1904; pol. mag., Kandy, July, 1905; dist. judge, Kalutara, Dec., 1910; ag. dist. judge, Kurunegala, June, 1915; dist. judge, Batticaloa, Aug., 1915; acted on two occasions in 1916 and 1916 as addtl. agt. gov't. K. Prov. in addition to his own duties; comnr. of requests, Colombo, Mar., 1918; dist. judge, Galle, Nov., 1920; gov't. agt., S. Prov., Feb., 1924.

RUSSELLI, SIR WILLIAM ALISON, KT. BACH. (1928), K.C.—B. 1875; ed. Rugby and Trin. Coll. Camb.; B.A., LL.B., honours, 1897; barrister-at-law, Inner Temp., 1900; equity bar, 1900-6; apptd. Crown advoc., pub. proscr., admnr.-gen., prin. regis. of docnts., regis. of companies, Uganda Prot., May, 1906; Crown advoc. and pub. proscr., Jan., 1909; ag. chief sec. to gvt., Aug., 1909, to Mar., 1910; Crown advoc. and pub. proscr., Mar. to May, 1910; ag. chief sec. to gvt., June, 1910 to May, 1911; Crown advoc. and pub. proscr., June, 1911 to June, 1912; King's advoc., Cyprus, July, 1912; mem. of exec. and legis. couns., 1912; joint comnr. under Reprint of Statutes Law, 1913;
edition pubd., Feb., 1914; K.C., Cyprus, 1924; ch. just., Tanganyika Territory, 1925; published "Legislative and Other Forms" (1924) and "Handbook for Magistrates" (1927).

RUTHERFORD, GEORGE JAMES, M.R.C.S., L.R.C.P., Lond.—Ed. at Epsom Coll., and Middlesex Hosp.; ast. col. surg., G. Coast, 1897; on spec. serv. in Lagos during the Sarki expdn., 1897-98; sen. med. offr., G. Coast, 1907; sen. med. officer, S. Nigeria, 1907; prov. med. offr., Ashanti, 1910; ast. prin. civ. med. offr. and instr. gen. of hospitals, Ceylon, 1911; Ceylon deleg. at "All India" sanitary conf., 1911-12; ag. prin. civ. med. offr., Ceylon, Oct. to Dec., 1912, Feb. to Dec., 1913, and from June to Aug., 1915; prin. civ. med. offr. and instr. gen. of hosps., Aug., 1915; M.L.C.; sec., col. advisory med. and san. comte. at C.O., 1924.

RUTHERFORD, CAPT. PETER WILLIAM, M.C. (1916), F.R.G.S.—B. 1894; ed. Brighton Coll.; 2nd lieut. W. Yorks Regt., 1914; lieut., 1915; seconded, Flying Corps, 1916; capt., 1917; retd. from army, 1919; ast. dist. commr., G. Coast, 20th Sept., 1921.

RUXTON, MAJOR UPTON FITZHERBERT, C.M.G.—B. 1873; ast. res., Nigeria, 6th Feb., 1901; 2nd cls. res., 1st Oct., 1902; 1st cls. res., 1st Oct., 1908; seconded to Adm'y., 1st Apr., 1916 to 27th May, 1919; seconded to F.O. for polit. duties, Constantinople, 23rd May, 1919; returned to Nigeria, 14th Aug., 1921; lieut.-gov., S. Provs., Nigeria, 17th Oct., 1925.

RYAN, HUGH KAYE, M.A., LL.M., etc. (Cantab.)—Barrister-at-Law, Inner Temple (1906); mem., Western Circuit; special pleader; author of several legal works; mag., B.E. Africa, 1913; joined Inns of Court O.T.C., 1914; depot adjutant; selected by mily. authorities for secret work, 1917; seconded for serv., Royal Engineers, 1918; joined directorate, I.W. and D., War Office; ment. in despatches and awarded O.B.E. (mily. divn.); ast. atty.-gen., Jamaica, 1918; ag. atty.-gen., 1922; D.B.C., Cyprus, 1923.

RYCROFT, MAJ.-GEN. SIR WILLIAM HENRY, K.C.B. (1919), K.C.M.G. (1918), C.M.G. (1915), C.B. (1910).—B. 1861; ed. Eton and Sandhurst; joined 71st H.L.I., 1879; served in Nile expdn. (including desert march to Metemneh), 1884-85 (medal and clasp and bronze star); Egyptian Army, 1886-87; action of Sarras (despa., 4th cls., Medjidie); promoted into 7th Dragoon Guards, 1888; staff coll., 1891-92; D.A.A.G., York, 1895-96; promoted into 11th Hussars, 1896; commanded 11th Hussars, 1904-8; staff, S. Africa, 1911-12; A.Q.M.G., Southern Command, 1913-14; service, N.W. Frontier of India, 1897-98 (medal and clasp); D.A.A.G., Cairo, 1898-99; served in S. Africa on staff, 1899-1900 (despa., medal and 2 clasps); Somaliland, 1902-3 (despa., medal with clasp); European War, 1914-18 (despa., 7 times, prom. maj. gen., Knight of Grace, St. John of Jerusalem, Legion of Honour, Croix de Commandeur, Orders of White Eagle of Serbia, Redeemer of Greece, Star of Roumania, Greek Order of Merit 2nd cls.); retd. pay, 1921; gov., N. Borneo, 1922.

RYRIE, MAJ.-GEN. HON. SIR GRANVILLE DE LAUNE, K.C.M.G. (1919), C.B. (1918), C.M.G. (1916), V.D.—B. 1865; ed. King's Sohl., Parramatta; mem., state parl., N.S.W., 3 years, mem., house of reps., C. of A., 1911-27; ast. min., for defence, 1919-22; commanded 3rd Light Horse Regt., N.S.W., for 7 yrs. with rank of lieut.-col.; served S. Africa, 1900-01 (severely wounded (Queen's med. 4 clasps); European War, 1914-18; commanded 2nd Light Horse Brig., A.I.F., Egypt; commanded Australian divn., Syria; G.O.C., Australian Forces, Egypt (wounded twice, five times ment. in desps.); maj.-gen. commdg. 1st Cav. Divn., N.S.W., 1923-27; high commr. for Australia, 1927.

SADLER, C.—Ast. gen. man., govt. rly., Trinidad, 1st Dec., 1914; traffic man., Nigerian govt. rly., Aug., 1922; gen. man., Trinidad govt. rly., 16th Jan., 1926.

SAINTSBURY, JOHN SEYMOUR.—Called to the bar, Lincoln's Inn, 1906; 1st cls. in evidence, procedure and criminal law, bar exams., 1904; certif. of honour from council of legal educ. at Bar Final, 1905, and a prize of 50L., from the Inn; passed civ. ser. test exam., Barbados, 1882; supernumerary, col. sec.'s off., 1883; in P.O., 1884; 7th clsk., P.O., June, 1886; 4th clsk., audit off., Sept., 1890; offr. of cust., Dec., 1890; inland rev. offr., Oct., 1905; ag. pol. mag., dist. "E," July to Nov., 1906; ag. pol. mag., dist. "A," June to Nov., 1911, and from Apr., 1912 to June, 1913; ag. judge, Bridgetown petty debt ct., 30th June to 31st Oct., 1913; pol. mag. and judge of petty debt ct., dist. F., Sept., 1915; pol. mag., dist. "E," 1919; judge, Bridgetown petty debt ct., 1921; judge, ast. ct. of appeal, 1925; regiar., 1925.

ST. JOHNSTON, LIEUT.-COL. THOMAS REGINALD, C.M.G. (1923), Barrister-at-law (Middle Temple); M.R.C.S., L.R.C.P., Lond., etc.—Ed. Queen Elizabeth Coll., Guernsey and Cheltenham Coll.; various appts. in home civ. service; entered Fiji civ. serv., 1907; commr. Lau Islands, 1909; seconded for European war; D.A.D.M.S., B.E.F., France; subsequently attached to W.O. (brevet lieut.-col. and recd. thanks of S. of S.); col. sec., Falkland Is., Dec., 1918; ag. gov., Falkland Is., from Sept. 1919 to Apr., 1920; col. sec., Leeward Islds., Dec., 1919; assumed duty, June, 1920; ag. gov., Leeward Is., 1920, twice in 1921, 1923, 1924 and in 1926; admstd. govt. of Antigua on many occasions; ag. admstr., Dominica, 1925; admstr., St. Kitts-Nevia, 9th May, 1925; assumed duty, 23rd Nov., 1925; ag. gov., Leeward Is., 1927; author of "The Lau Islands, Fiji," "The Children of the Sun," "The Falkland Islands," "The Islanders of the Pacific," "South Sea Reminiscence," "West Indian Tales" and some novels, etc.

SALIER, LIEUT.-COL. EDWARD LUCAS.—B. 1882; ed. Hutchins Sch., Hobart, Tasmania; 2nd lieut., 4th K.S.L.I., 1903; Northumberland Fusiliers, 1906; India, N.W. Frontier, 1908; seconded S. Nigeria Regt., W.A.F.F., 1910; ast. regt. adjt., S.N. Regt., 1910; regt. adj., S.N. Regt., 1911-13; adjt., 3rd S.N. Regt., 1914; S.O., Fly and Cross River Columns, W.A.F.F., Cameroons, 1914; adjt., 2nd Northumberland Fusiliers, France, Belgium, Salonika, 1915; severely wounded, 1915; brig. major, 12th Australian Inf'y. Brig., France, Belgium, 1916-17; brevet major, June, 1917; G.S.O. II., Tank Corps, 1917; in commd., 1st Northumberland Fusiliers, 1918; G.S.O. I., Tank Corps, 1918; temp. lieut.-col., 1918; six times ment. in desp.; M.C., Legion of Honour, brevet major; in commd., 4th Nigeria Regt., W.A.F.F., 1920-21; Reg. Army, R. of O., Lieut.-Col., May, 1921; resigned, 31st Mar., 1926; contr. lab., Ascension Island (St. Helena Colony), Aug., 1925.

SALISBURY, THOMAS RONALD FFOLKES.—B. 1882; served in Fiji, and under the condominium govt., New Hebrides; govt. agt., New Hebrides, 18th Mar., 1922.
SALOMONE, WALTER.—B. 1886; ed. St. Ignatius Coll. and Malta Univ.; elec. for 6th divn. in leg. assem., Oct., 1921; re-elec., June, 1924 and Aug., 1927; min. for industry and commerce, 16th Aug., 1927.

SAMBIDGE, GERALD CHURCHILL.—B. 1886; ed. King Edward's Sch., Birmingham; served Nigeria Regt., 27th Mar., 1915; instr. in arts and crafts, N. Provs., Nigeria, 1st Dec., 1920.

SAMUEL RT. HON. SIR HERBERT LOUIS, P.C. (1908), G.B.E. (1920), M.A.—B. 1870; ed. University Coll. Schl. and Balliol Coll., Oxford; M.P., Cleveland Divn., N. Riding, Yorks., 1902-18; parly. under sec., home dept., 1905-9; chancellor of the Duchy of Lancaster (with a seat in the cabinet), 1909-10 and 1915-16; P.M.G., 1910-14 and 1915-16; pres. of the L.G.B., 1914-15; sec. of state for home affairs, 1916; chmn. of the select comtes. of house of commons on national expenditure, 1917-18; British sp. commr. to Belgium, 1919; grand offr. of the Order of Leopold of Belgium, 1919; high commr., Palestine, 1920-25.

SAMUEL SILVERIO I., M.B.E. (1924).—Ed. at St. Gregory's Rom. Cath. gram. schl., Lagos; messr. and copyt., educ. off., Oct., 1897; clk. to inspr. of schls., Mar., 1899; sec. to comtes. for exhibtn. of schl. wks., 1902 and 1903; clk. and interpreter to trav. commr., Ilesha, interior dept., Feb., 1904; 3rd cls. clk., govt.'s off., Aug., 1904; conf. clk. to the gov. of Nigeria.

'SAMUELS, WILLIAM FREDERICK.—B. 1876; ed. Chesterfield Sch. Birr., King's Co., Ireland, Corrig Sch., Kingstown and Trinity Coll., Dublin; med. offr. and mag., Anguilla, B.W. Indies, Apr., 1909; med. supt., cent. mental hosp., F.M.S., Dec., 1910; publications, "General paralyses of the Insane in the F.M.S." (Jnl. of Mental Science, Apr., 1916); "A case of Pellagra in the Cent. Asylum, Tanjong Rambutan, F.M.S." (Jnl. of Mental Science, Oct., 1917); "Malaria and Insanity" (Transactions of the Far Eastern Assn. of Trop. Med., 1923); "A History of the Central Mental Hosp., Tanjong Rambutan" (Jnl. of Mental Science, Jan., 1926).

SAMUT, COL. ACHILLE, C.B. (1918), C.M.G. (1902), F.R.G.S.—R. Malta Arty., 1878; attd. to auxiliary transport, Egypt, 1882; A.O.D., 1898; served in Malta, Portsmouth, Royal Arsenal, Woolwich, Aldershot and Weeden; S. Africa, 1889-1902; ch. ordnance offr., Natal, 1901; Transvaal, 1902; ment. in desps.; awarded 2 medals, 5 clasps; European war, 1914-18; ment. in desps.; War and Victory medals; elec. senator, Malta, Oct., 1921; served as del. for Malta on Empire parly. deleg. to Australia, 1926; re-ele., senator, Aug., 1927; min. for treasury, 16th Aug., 1927.

SANDBERSON, G. M.—M.R.C.S., L.R.C.P., med. offr., Nyasaland, 1910; temp. major, Nyasaland Field Force, Aug., 1914; sanitation offr., Nov., 1921; ag. D.M.S.S., 1927.

SANDBERSON, JAMES.—Ck. to ch. just., Barbados, 1867; clk. to gen. bd. of health, Barbados, Apr., 1871, also clk. to quarantine bd. in 1880; solr., atty., and proctor, Barbados, in 1873; was deleg. for Barbados to quarantine confe. at Demerara in 1888; govt. dir. on bd. of Barbados rly. co. in 1891; commr. of probates, 1904; J.P., 1904.

SANDFORD, GEORGE RITCHIE, O.B.E. (1924), Barrister-at-Law, Inner Temple, 1924.—Asst. dist. commr., E. Africa Prot., Feb., 1915; priv. sec. to gov., 1918; junr. asst. sec. and clk. of couns., Sept., 1922; ag. senr. asst. sec., Mar. to Sept., 1923; resig., 1925; clk. to leg. coun., Jan., 1926; edr., official gazette, Mar., 1926.

SANDS, WILLIAM H.—B. 1869 pub. schl. teacher, Bahamas, 1889; Out Island commr. (4th div.) and teacher, 1917.

SANDYS, MELVILL KEVERNE TRELAUNTY, M.A. (Oxon.).—B. 1890; on mily. serv., Aug., 1914; cadet, Ceylon civ. serv., Nov., 1919; attd., Ratnapura Kach., Nov., 1919; office ast. to gov't. agt., N.W. Prov., Mar., 1922; ag. ast. govt. agt., Puttalum, Oct., to Dec., 1922; ag. ast. govt. agt., Mullaitivu, July, 1923; dist. judge, Anuradhapura, July, 1925; pol. mag., Kurunegala, Oct., 1926; ag. ast. Hambantota, May, 1927; ag. dist. judge, Tangalla, June, 1927; ast. govt. agt., Uva, July, 1927; ag. ast. govt. agt., Matare, Aug., 1927; ast. stlitmt., offr., Oct., 1927.

SANGER-DAVIES, ARTHUR ELPHINSTONE.—B. 1885; ed. Dover Coll., Coopers Hill and Oxford (Diploma of Forestry, 1907); ast. conservator, forests, grade II., F.M.S. forest dept., 1907; grade I., 1912; dep. conservator, forests, 1919; ag. conserv., forests, S.S. and F.M.S., June, 1923; dep. conserv., forests, Oct., 1923.

SANSON, CHARLES HENRY.—B. 1896; ed. Plymouth and Munnamead Coll.; Barrister-at-law, Middle Temple, 1923; pol. probationer, 1905; ag. ast. commr. of pol., 1908; ag. reg'istrar of criminals, Selangor, 1909; reg'istrar of criminals, F.M.S. and S.S., 1910; ast. commr. of pol., Ipoh, 1911; adjt., F.M.S. pol., 1913-20; commr. of pol., Johore, 1921-24; ag. commr. of pol., F.M.S., 1924.

SARAVANAMUTTU, P.—B. 1894; B.A., Lond.; cadet, Ceylon civ. serv., local divn., Aug., 1919; attached to Colombo, Kach., Aug., 1919; ag. office ast. to govt. agt., Kalutara, Feb., 1920; attd. to Matale Kach., June, 1920; addnl. dist. judge, Badulla, Mar., 1921; pol. mag., Dandawatuwa, Sept., 1921; ditto, Kurunegala, June, 1922; addnl. ast. govt. agt., Colombo, Mar., 1923; addnl. ast. dir., educ., Dec., 1925; ast. govt. agt., Mullaitivu, Dec., 1926.

SARGENT, CAPT. R. G., A.I.N.A., F.R.G.S.—Port. offr., Kenya, Jan., 1921; port capt., 1925.

SARGENT, JOHN DENYS, B.A. (Oxon), Dipl., Forestry, Oxford.—B. 1885; ast. conserv., forests, Ceylon, Dec., 1909; dep. conserv., grade II., Apr., 1917; grade I., May, 1919; conserv., Sept., 1921.

SARWAR, HAFIZ GHULAM.—Cadet, S. S., Sept., 1897; ag. 3rd mag., Singapore, Jan. to June, 1900; and from Sept., 1900, to Nov., 1901; passed final exam., Chinese July, 1900; 3rd mag., Sing., 29th Apr., 1902; ag. sherif, deputy-reg'istrar, and ast. official assignee, Penang, May, 1902; dep. reg'istrar, sup. ct., Penang, Dec., 1905; ast. reg'istrar, sup. ct., Malacca, May, 1907; dep. reg'istrar, sup. ct., Penang, Apr., 1908; ag. reg'istrar, July, 1909; ag. dist. judge, May, 1915; ag. censor, Dec., 1915 to Jan., 1916; ag. offl. assignee, Penang, in addition, May, 1916; reg'istrar, and sheriff, sup. ct., Penang, also ast. reg'istrar of ooe., Penang, Jan., 1917; offr., cls. II., Jan., 1919.

SAUNDERS, CHARLES JAMES, B.A.—B. 1868; ed. Merchant Taylors and St. John's Coll., Oxon.; cadet, S. S., 1891; passed final exam. in Chin., Feb., 1895; ag. 2nd ast. prot. of Chin., Feb., 1895; 3rd mag., Sing., May, 1895; ag. 3rd mag., Penang, Dec., 1896; ag. dist. offr., Penang, Mar., 1897; dist. offr., Malacca, May, 1897; ag. ast. prot. of Chin., Sing., Aug., 1897; ag. ast. prot. of Chin., and supt. of Ind. immgr., Penang, and music commr. for Penang, 1898; ag. ast. prot. of Chin., Sing., Aug., 1898, to Feb., 1899; also ag. 3rd
mag., Sing., Sept., 1898; 2nd asst. prot. of Chin., Penang, Aug., 1898; ag. 2nd mag., Sing., May, 1900; ag. offl. assignee, S.S., Sept. to Dec., 1900, Jan., 1901, to Feb., 1905, and Feb., 1906; sheriff, dep.-regisr., supreme court, and asst. official assignee, Penang, May, 1902; munici. comsnr. for Sing., Oct., 1900, and Sept., 1903; also ag. prot. of Chin., Sing., Apr., 1904; also asst. supt. of India's immigr.; asst. prot. of Chin., Penang, May, 1904; ag. sec. for Chin. affairs, S.S. and F.M.S., Apr., 1907: ag. comsnr., ct. of requests, Singapore, Jan., 1908; ag. dist. judge, Apr., 1908; sec. for Chinese affairs, S.S. and F.M.S., Feb., 1910; ag. offl. assignee, Mar., 1914; regisr. of cos. and offl. assignee, Jan., 1915; pres., rent assessment bd., Sept., 1917.

SAUNDERS, Sir Charles James Renault, K.C.M.G., 1906. C.M.G., 1895.—B. 1857; held various apptmts. in Natal civ. ser., 1876-87, when he ratified treaty with Queen of Amatongaland (deeps.); res. mag., Eshowe, and J.P. for Zululand, 1888; defined bndry. between Amatongaland and Zululand, 1889 (deeps.); variously employed under Zululand Govt., 1888-95 (deeps.), when he was apptd. spec. comsnr. for Trans-Pongoland territory, carried out final act of annexation of that territory and declared British prot. for Amatongaland; acted as res. comsnr. and chief mag. of Zululand, 1896; apptd. chief mag. and civ. comsnr. for prov. of Zululand on its incorporation with Natal, 1897; medal, S. African War, 1899-1902; col. representative on Zululand Lands Delimitation Comsn., 1902, and comsnr. for native affairs, 1905; ret., 1909.

SAUNDERS, John C.—B. 1862; cd. pub. schls. and High Schl., Halifax, N.S.; ent. pub. serv., 23rd Mar., 1882; transferred to finance dept., Ottawa, 1st July, 1887; asst. dep. min. of finance, 1st Jan., 1917; dep. min. of finance, 1st Apr., 1920.

SAUNDERS-JONES, David Willoughby.—B. 1899; ed. Christ Coll., Brecon; Indian Army, 1917-23; on service in Waziristan, Egypt and Palestine; wounded in Palestine, 1919; asst. dist. comsnr., Zanzibar, Feb., 1924.

SAVAGE, George.—B. 1887; supt. of registration, G.I.P.O., Singapore, Oct., 1914; supt. of mails, ditto, 1st Jan., 1915; ag. supt. of mails, Penang, Jan., 1915; ag. senr. supt. of mails, Feb., 1917; supt. of mails, Penang, but continued ag. senr. supt. of mails, July, 1917; supt., grade II., Jan., 1919; ag. supt., money order branch and savings dept., May, 1919 and Nov., 1920; supt., grade I., but cont. to act as above, Jan., 1920; supt., posts and telegraphs, Malacca, Sept., 1920; ag. supt., money order branch and savings bank dept., 27th Nov., 1920; ag. asst. P.M.G., Singapore, 1st Apr., 1921; ag. acctnt., G.P.O., Singapore, 26th July, 1921 to 1st Nov., 1921; ag. asst. P.M.G., 26th July, 1922.

SAVAGE, John Lewis Henry William.—B. 1884; col. schol., Trinidad, 1901; Gray's Inn, 1902; prizeman in evidence, procedure and criminal law exam., 1904; barrister-at-law, Nov., 1905; practised at bar, Trinidad, 1906-24; retainer from Trinidad govt. as jun. coun. to atty-gen., Jan., 1916-Dec., 1923; ag. solr. gen., June to Oct., 1921 and Nov., 1922-Nov., 1923; regisr. and marshal and regisr.-gen. and prin. regisr., West Indian ct. of appeal, Jan., 1925; ag. puisne judge, May-June, 1925, Oct., 1925-Apr., 1926 and from June, 1926.

SAVI, Victor George.—Pol. probationer, S. Sttlmts., Nov., 1904; asst. supt.of pol., Jan., 1908; passed final exam. in Punjaubi, Feb., 1910: ag. 2nd supt. of pol., Aug., 1910 and Feb., 1914; ag. supt. of pol., Malacca, Sept., 1916; asst. supt. of pol., Penang, Oct., 1917; ag. dir., crim. intelligence, Jan., 1919; dir., crim. intelligence, Jan., 1920; ag. supt., pol. and ch. pol. offr., Singapore, May, 1921; dep. comsnr., pol., Perak, Mar., 1922; ag. dep. pub. pros., Perak, in addn., July, 1925.

SAWARD, Capt. Sidney Carmon, M.C. (1916), M.M. (1916).—B. 1889; fellow of surveyors' inst.; served with 509 (1-1) Lond. Field Coy., R.E., 6th divn.; home serv., 6th Aug. to 11th Dec., 1914; France and Germany, 12th Dec., 1914 to June, 1919; Ireland, June to Aug., 1919; commdg., cadre, 12th Field Co., R.E.; comsmd., 8th Sept., 1915; lieut., 1st June, 1916; capt., 22nd Oct., 1918; ag. major, 4th Dec., 1918 to 29th Jan., 1919; ment. in despe., 16th Mar., 1919; survr., Gold Coast, 5th Nov., 1919; field supervisor, 1st Apr., 1924; ag. dep. survr.-gen., 14th Feb. to 4th Aug., 1925, 21st Apr. to 31st Aug., 1926 and from 27th Oct., 1926.

SAWREY-COOKSON, Sydney Spencer, B.A.—B. 1876; ed. Uppingham and New Coll., Oxford; barrister-at-law, Inner Temple, 1903; judicial comsnr., Brit. N. Borneo, 1910-20; judge, sup. ct., Gambia, 1920; puisne judge, Gold Coast, 11th June, 1925.

SAXTON, Sidney Waring.—Ed. Toulouse (France), and Dean Close Schl., Cheltenham; paymr. cadet, R.N., 14th July, 1906; paymr.-lieut.-comdr., 19th Mar., 1918; 1st cls. French interpreter; lent to C.O. and apptd. asst. dist. comsnr., G. Coast, 15th Sept., 1914, but did not take up apptmt., having resumed duty in H.M. Navy for the period of the war; assumed duties as junr. asst. col. sec., G. Coast, 16th Apr., 1919; ag. asst. col. sec., 16th May, 1919; ag. dist. comsnr., Accra, and ag. trav. comsnr. for Accra-Akwapim and Birrim dists., 30th Oct., 1919; invalided, H.M. Navy, 1920; passed Tropical African service course (all subjects, 2nd part); barrister-at-law, Middle Temple, 1925; promoted pay commdr., ret. list, 1927.

SAYER, Geoffrey Robley, B.A.—B. 1887; ed. at Highgate schl. (foundationer) and Queen's Coll., Oxford; open exhibitioner in classics and Fitzgerald exhibitioner; 2nd cls. class. mods.; 3rd cls. Lit. Hum. (B.A., 1910); cadet, Hong Kong, 24th Oct., 1910; passed in Cantonese, Nov., 1912; ag. asst. dist. offr. (South), 1912 to 1913; ag. asst. supt. of police, 1913 to 1914; ag. dep. offl. recvr., 1914 to 1915; ag. chief asst. sec. for Chinese affairs 1914 and 1915, in addition to other duties; priv. sec. to gov., in addition to other duties, 1915; attached to crown solr.'s off., 1915; passed final exam. in Hakka, July, 1915; ag. chief asst. sec. for Chinese affairs, 1916; on milly. serv., 1915-19; dep. regisr. and appraiser, Hong Kong, 1920; head of sany. dept., 1920; passed in Mandarin, May, 1921; attd. to treasy., 1924; asst. treas. and comsnr. of estate duties, Apr. 1925; supt., impts. and expts. dept., June, 1927.

SAYERS, Eldred Frank.—B. 1889; ed. King's Coll. Schl., Wimbledon, St. John's Coll., Cambridge, and Grenoble Univ., B.A., LL.B. (Cantab.); barrister-at-law (Inner Temple), Apr., 1913; passed lower and higher stand. exams. in Temne, and lower stand. exam. in Koranko; war service, E. Africa, 1918; asst. dist. comsnr., Sierra Leone, 1st Jan., 1915; dist. comsnr., 21st Aug., 1922.

SAYERS, Frederick Richardson.—M.D., D.P.H., Dublin Univ.; ed. Rathmines Schl., Dublin, The Meath Hosp., Dublin, and Trin.
from 20th May, 1889; acted as dep. regir. or as sheriff and dep. regir., Singapore, on several occasions since 1893; confirmed as sheriff and dep. regir., 1st Jan., 1902; ag. offr. assignee in addition to own duties, Sept. to Oct., 1907; dep. regir. sup. ct., and sheriff in addition, Dec., 1908, and again Apr., 1914; ag. regir., sup. ct., Jan., 1909; hon. gen. sec., agri-horticultural shows in addition, May to Aug., 1910; asst. supt. Indian immigr., May, 1912; ag. marshal, prize ct. in addition, Aug., 1914; in charge of regir. and sheriff's office, Dec., 1917.

RODRIGO, EDMUND.—B. 1889; cadet, Ceylon civ. serv., Dec., 1912; attached to Kurunegala Kachcheri, Mar., 1913; ag. pol. mag., Negombo, Nov., 1913; office asst. to govt. agt., W. Prov., May, 1915; mun. mag., Colombo, Oct., 1915; pol. mag., Puttalam, July, 1917; office asst. to govt. agt., Prov. of Sabaragamuwa, Sept., 1918; dist. judge, Batticaloa, Apr., 1920; ditto, Matale, May, 1922; asst. comsrr., excise, Sept., 1924; dep. comsrr., excise, Sept., 1927.

RODRIGUEZ, FAUSTIN ALBERT, M.B., C.M. (Edin.)—B. 1867; entd. med. ser., Trinidad, 1st May, 1904; dist. med. offr., 1st May, 1904.

RODWELL, SIR CECIL HUNTER, K.C.M.G. (1919), C.M.G. (1909).—B. Eton and King's Coll., Camb., B.A., 1897; serv. on staff of high comsrr. for S. Africa since Dec., 1900; Imperial sec., Mar., 1904; gov., Fiji, and high comsrr., W. Pacific, 8th Apr., 1918; assumed duty, 10th Oct., 1918; gov. and commdr. in ch., B. Guiana, 1926.

ROGERS, ARTHUR WILLIAM, Sc.D., F.R.S.—B. 1872; ed. Clifton Coll. and Christ's Coll., Camb.; Harkness scholar, Camb.; geologist, geological comsrr., Cape of Good Hope, 1896; asst. dir., geological surv., Union of S. Africa, 1st Apr., 1912; dir. geological survey of Union of S. Africa, 1917.

ROGERS, WALTER ERNEST.—B. 1864; entd. civ. serv., S. Australia, 9th Mar., 1882; 2nd clk., audit dept., 1st Feb., 1912; audr.-gen., S. Aust., 1923.

ROGERSON, WALTER JOHN LANCASHIRE, B.A., Cantab.—B. 1889; Cadet, Ceylon civ. serv., Dec., 1912; attached to Kandy Kachcheri, Jan., 1913; ag. additional office asst., Anuradhapura Kach., Jan., 1914; ag. asst. govt. agt., Trincomalee, May, 1914; addtl. office asst. Anuradhapura, June, 1914; ag. office asst. to govt. agt., Kandy, June, 1914; ag. asst. govt. agt., Matale, Sept., 1914; office asst. to govt. agt., Badulla, Sept., 1914; pol. mag., Matale, Jan., 1915; office asst. to govt. agt., Kandy, May, 1917; pol. mag., Avisawella, Jan., 1921; ditto, Kandy, Feb., 1921; dist. judge Kegalla, Sept., 1922; pol. mag., Colombo, July, 1923; asst. govt. agt., Colombo, Nov., 1925; ag. asst. govt. agt., Matale, Apr., 1926.

ROLAND, FREDERICK MALCOLM.—Called to bar, Middle Temple, 1913; mag., county St. Patrick, Trinidad, 1st Mar., 1926.

ROLLESTON, HON. FRANCIS JOSEPH, B.A., LL.B.—B. 1873; ed. Christ's Coll. and Canterbury Univ. Coll., N.Z.; entd. N.Z. parl., 1922; min. of defence, min. of just. and atty.-gen., 1926.

ROLSTON, CECIL MICHELL.—M.D., C.M., Univ. of Manitoba, Canada, 1895; L.R.C.P., Edin.; L.R.C.S., Edin.; L.R.F.P. and S., Glasgow, 1898; mem. Coll. of Phys. and Surgeons, 1903; F.R.I., publ. health, London; late civil surg., attached to R.A.M.C. during S. African war, 1900-1902 (Queen's medal, 2 clasps; King's medal, 2 clasps); apptd. to Leeward Is. med. serv., 1903; med. offr., dist. "D," Dominica, and ag. med. offr. of pub. institns., 1903; dist. med. offr. of health, Vancouver, B. Columbia, 1908; med. offr., dist. 8, Nevis, 1914; ag. mag., Nevis, May to June, 1915; med. offr., dist. 6, Nevis, Sept., 1915.

ROOS, J. DE V., B.A., LL.B.—B. 1869; advoc. of sup. ct., Cape Colony; ditto, S.A.R.; attorney etc., of sup. ct. of S.A.R.; sworn translate: in English, Dutch and Portuguese, sup. ct., Transvaal; Cape partly, service, 1893-7; ag. sec. of law dept., Transvaal, 1st Dec., 1908; ditto and ag. dir. prisons, Transvaal, 1st Jan., 1909; sec. to law dept., 1st May, 1909; re-admitted advoc., sup. ct., Transvaal, 28th June, 1909; dir., prisons, 1st July, 1909; sec. for just. and dir. prisons, Union of S. Africa, 1st Apr., 1912; ag. contr. and audr.-gen., 1st Aug., 1918; contr. and audr.-gen., 9th Dec., 1918; mem., American rly. accntng. offrs.' assn.; mem., joint comtes. of the universities for professional exams.; mem., société de comptabilité de France.

ROOS, HON. TIELMAN J. DE V., K.C.—M.L.A. for divn. of Lichtenburg, Union of S. Africa since 1915; min. of just., 30th June, 1924.

ROOTS, NEVILLE, M.Inst.C.E.—Ed. Tonbridge Schol. and City and Guilds Engnr. Coll., S. Kensington; held various engnr. appts. in U.K., 1897-1904; inspgr. engnr., P.W.D., Jamaica, 1908; asst. dir., P.W.D., 1914; ag. dir., Apr., 1920 to Sept., 1921; dep. dir., Apr., 1922.

ROPER, WILLIAM JAMES.—B. 1891; entd. O.A. office, 1907; seconded to Falkland Is., Aug., 1912; ag. priv. sec. to admstrn. and olk. to couns., Aug., 1913; olk. clk. to col. sec., Jan., 1914; ag. local auditor, Nov., 1914; returned to C.A. office, 1915; served European war (M.G.C., France), 1916-1919; 1st cls. clk., Nyassaland, 15th Jan., 1920; ag. ch. clk., July to Dec., 1921; editor, Gazette, Oct., 1921 to Dec., 1922; ag. 2nd asst. sec. and clk. to exec. and leg. couns., Jan. to Nov., 1922, Mar. to Nov., 1925 and from May to Nov., 1926; organising sec., Nyassaland Vol. Res., Sept., 1926: ag. ch. transport offr., Dec., 1926 to May, 1927.

ROSE, HON. HUGH EDWARD.—B. 1869; ed. at Jarvis St. Collegiate Inst., Univ. of Toronto; (B.A., 1891; LL.B., 1892), and Osgoode Hall; mem. of the firm of Fasken, Cowan, Chadwick and Rose; called to the bar, Ontario, 1894; K.C., 1908; judge of the sup. ct., Ontario, 4th Dec., 1916; examr. in law for some years for University of Toronto and the Law Society of Upper Canada.

ROSEBY, THOMAS ERNEST.—B. 1868; ed. at Sydney Univ.; M.A.; honouram in French and German; senr. clk., Royal Mint, Sydney, 1885-1896; called to the bar, New S. Wales, 1896; also to high ct., of Australia; called to the bar, Mid. Temp., 1912; crown procur., N.S. Wales assizes, 1902-3; Brit. judge of joint ct. and judicial commr. for the New Hebrides, Nov., 1908; thanked by S. of S. for memoranda on land suits, 1910; co-author of the joint ct. civ., criminal and land registration procedure codes; puisne judge, sup. ct., Mauritius, Feb., 1917; chmn. of govt. wages comn., 1919; chmn. of comtes. to advise on treatment of former enemy aliens, 1919; chmn., govt. scholarship grants comttee, and chmn., rly. enquiry comn., 1923; chmn., Curepipe bd. enquiry comn., 1926-7.

ROSS, ALEXANDER HOWARD.—B. 1880; ed. Epsom Coll. and on H.M.S. "Worcester"; supervisor of customs, Gold Coast, 1908; ag. inspr., P.S., 1908 and 1909; ag. dist. comsrr. and
travelling comsnr., 1908 and 1909 in Ashanti and Northern Territories; asst. dist. comsnr. Ashanti, 1910; ag. prov. comsnr., 1912 and 1913; ag. dist. comsnr., 1913; dist. comsnr., 1914; ag. prov. comsnr., Mar. to Oct., 1916; passed in criminal law, Tropical African Service Course; dist. comsnr., 1917-18; ag. prov. comsnr., Mar. to Sept., 1919; ag. sec., native affrs., May to June, 1919; prov. comsnr., Sierra Leone, May, 1920.

ROSS, CHARLES RICHARD.—Clt., P.O. savings bank, Cape, 1890; agric. dept., 1904; clk. and acctnt., office of conservator of forests, Midland Conservancy, Cape, 1895; dist. forest offr., George, Cape, 1897; Kokstad, Transkei, 1901; asst. conservator of forests, Transkeian conservancy, 1907; transf. to King William’s Town, 1910; conservator of forests, Eastern conservancy, Cape, 1st Apr., 1912; ditto, Western conservancy, Oct., 1916.

ROSS, EDWARD ANDREW.—B. 1895; ed. Leigh Gram. Schl. and Manchester Univ.; on active serv., 1914-19; M.C.; relinquished coman., 1921 with rank of capt.; cadet, F.M.S., 1920; ag. asst. contr. of lab., May, 1921; superv. offr., cls. V., May, 1923; ag. dep. contr., lab., Kuala Lumpur, Dec., 1923; ag. asst. dist. offr., lands, Kinta, Mar., 1924; asst. cont. lab., Penang, Mar., 1925; ag. dep. contr., lab. (B), Penang, Jan., 1926; ag. asst. emigrn. comsnr., Malaya, Negapatam, May, 1926; offr., cls. IV, May, 1927.

ROSS, GEORGE ARCHIBALD PARK, M.D., Ch.M. (Edin.), D.P.H. (Edin.); diploma, trop. diseases, Liverpool—B. 1879; S. African War, Lovat’s Scouts, 1900-02; Anglo-Portuguese bndry. coman., Zambesia, 1904-5; native rebellion, Natal, 1906; trop. diseases investig., 1906-10; govt. pathologist, Natal, 1911; asst. health offr., Union of S. Africa, stand. in Natal, 1918; major, S. African med. corps, in ch. sleeping sickness bureau, Durban, and sanitation offr., Natal, 1914-19.

ROSS, J. G. H.—Asst. dist. comsnr., E.A.P., Sept., 1919; ag. junr. dist. sec., Kenya, 10th Nov., 1919 to 26th Oct., 1919; ag. clk. of exec. and leg. couns., 12th Dec., 1919 to 14th Mar., 1920; editor, offl. Gazette, 6th Feb., 1920 to 31st Mar., 1920.

ROSS, JAMES PAULL.—B. 1881; ed. George Watson’s Coll. and Edin. Univ.; M.A.; writer to the Signet; capt., 6th Batt. The Royal Scots (Q.E.R.); declined to retain rank of capt. as permission to rejoin for war serv. refused; asst. dist. comsnr., G. Coast, 13th Aug., 1913; ag. asst. col. sec., Feb., 1918; dist. comsnr., 9th Apr., 1919; ag. pol. mag., Kumasi, 12th Apr., 1919 to 6th Feb., 1920; ag. asst. col. sec., 29th July to 31st Dec., 1920; ch. census offr. in addn., 1921; asst. col. sec., 1st Jan., 1921; ag. ch. regiar. and sheriff, 15th July, 1921 to 22nd Oct., 1921; senr. asst. col. sec., 15th Nov., 1921; pres. Acora town coun., 1921, 1923, 1924, 1926, 1926 and 1927; comsnr. for munic. affrs., 1st Apr., 1926.

ROSS, JAMES SANDFORD.—B. 1884; ed. Merchant Taylors Schl.; mily. serv., 1914-19; N.W. Frontier campaign, 1915; Salonica Field Force, 1916-19; asst. treas., Kenya, 1919.

ROSS, OSWALD F.—Ed. Malvern Coll. and Jesus Coll., Cambridge; capt., N. Staffs. Regt., European War; served Dardanelles expdn., 1916; Mesopotamia, 1916; passed A.T.S. course, 1920; asst. dist. comsnr., Gold Coast, 1920.

ROTH, WALTER E.—B.A. (Oxon), late Demy of Magd. Coll.; M.R.C.S. (Eng.); L.R.C.P. (Lond.); hon. mem. anthrop. societies of Berlin and Florence, and of anthrop. inst., Lond.; late ch. protector of aborigines, Queensland; and Royal comsnr. to inquire into condition of natives of W. Aust.; stip. mag., dep. prot. of Indians, and govt. med. offr., Pomeroon River, B. Guiana, 8th Dec., 1906; stip. mag., Demerara River, 1915; author of “Elements of School Hygiene,” 1886, “Theatre Hygiene,” 1888, “Ethnological Studies among the N.W. Central Aborigines, Queensland, 1897,” “N. Queensland Ethnography Bulletins,” “Superstitions, Magic and Medicine,” 1903; “Burial Ceremonies and Disposal of the Dead,” 1907, “Animism and Folk-lore of the Guiana Indians,” 1915, “Arts, Crafts and Customs of the Guiana Indians,” 1923; translator of Richard Schomburgk’s “Travels in Br. Guiana,” 1923.

ROUILLARD, JEAN EDMOND.—Ed. Roy. Coll., Maur., and King Henry VIII.’s schl., Coventry; called to bar, Mid. Tenn., 1891; licent. laws, Paris, 1891; ag. dist. mag., Plaines Wilhelms, Maur., Oct., 1899; ag. Crown pros., Feb., 1900; Crown pros., leg. advr., pol. mag., etc., Seychelles, 4th Sept., 1900; mag., Rodrigues, July, 1902; dist. and stip. mag., Mauritius, 1913; mast. and regiar., sup. ct., 1st July, 1927.

ROUSE, HAROLD STUART, C.E., A.M.I.C.E.—B. 1888; ed. Truro Coll. and Christ’s Hosp.; survr., P.W.D., Hong Kong, Feb., 1912; engnr., drainage wks. office, Dec., 1913; transf. to gen. wks. office, P.W.D., Apr., 1915; ag. exec. engnr., G.W.O., Sept., 1915-16 and from Feb., 1921 to Oct., 1922; offr. in charge, G.W.O., May, 1924.

ROUTH, REGINALD LAMY.—B. 1856; ed. St. Mary’s Hall, Southsea, and Cadet school; frigate, H.M.S. “Conway”; extra master’s certif., 1893; master of govt. vessels, Lagos, Apr., 1897; asst. marine supt., Lagos, Dec., 1902; ag. marine supt., Dec., 1903, to June, 1904; comdr., H.M.C.S.Y., “Ivy,” S. Nigeria, June, 1906; sen. marine offr., E. Prov., S. Nigeria, May, 1907.

ROWAN, ALBERTUS NICOLAAS.—Examr., deeds office, Transvaal, May, 1902; ch. examr., ditto, Oct., 1905; asst. regiar., deeds, Transvaal, Dec., 1918; regiar., deeds, mining rights, companies, patents, trade marks, designs and copyrights, S.W. Africa, Apr., 1922; regiar., deeds, Transvaal and Swaziland, Mar., 1925; mem., townships bd., Mar., 1925.

ROWATT, HUGH HOWARD.—B. 1861; ed., Ottawa Coll. Inst., and St. Catherine’s Affiliated Coll.; ent. civ. serv., Can., 1887, as correspondent; ch. clk., mining lands br., Mar., 1907; contrlr., mining lands, 1912; supt., 1920.

ROWE, GEORGE FREDERICK.—B. 1878; ent. Crown Agents’ office, 1896; asst. head, gen. stores dept., 1917; asst. head, pay dept., 1920; cashier, 1921; dep. head, finance dept., 1927.

ROWE, MAJOR R. H., D.S.O., M.C.—B. 1883; ed. Wellington Coll. and Royal Mil. Acad., Woolwich; Royal Arty., 1902-25; Bermuda and Jamaica, 1902-6; served with native infantry, Nigeria, 1907-10; Northern Hinterland expdn., 1907-8; Niger Cross River expdn., 1908-9; operations against Abini, 1909, and against Munchois, 1910; dep. dir., surveys, Nigeria, 1911; Nigeria-Dahomey bndry. comsnr., 1912; Great war (Cameroons, France and Russia), 1914-18; survr.-gen., Gold Coast, 1920; comsnr., lands, in addn., 1924; survr.-gen., Sierra Leone, in addn., 1925; Gold Coast rep. with staff of H.R.H. the Prince of Wales on his visit to W. Africa, 1925; chmn., comtees, on pub. wks. accts., rly. constrn., munie. finance and mil’y. defence; mem., leg. coun., 1926; comsnr., lands, Nigeria, 27th Oct., 1926.
Coll., Dublin; res. med. offr., Monkstown Hosp., Dublin, 1909-12; med. offr., S. Settmts., 23rd Mar., 1912; med. offr., gen. hosp., Penang, 27th Apr., 1912; med. offr., dist. hosp., Penang, 2nd June, 1912; port health offr. and health offr., rural areas, Penang, cor., Penang, and med. offr., in charge of leper asylum, Pulau Jerokaj, Penang, 3rd Sept., 1912; ag. ast. port health offr., Singapore, 10th Sept., 1912; resumed duties in Penang, 21st Oct., 1912; ast. censor, Penang, in addition, Sept., 1915, to Apr., 1916; ag. sen. health offr., S.
